output.reason: Evidence states that both “Fair Lending Practice - Penal Charges in Loan Accounts (2023)” and “Penal Charges in Loan Accounts: Extension of Timeline (2023)” were withdrawn/repealed by “Consolidation of Regulations - Withdrawal of circulars (2025)” effective 2025-11-28, and that on 2026-11-23 they “are no longer in force.” Therefore, as of 2026-11-23, the 2023 circular and its timeline extension have been withdrawn and are no longer in force.
